matches.quote: The symmetry argument that the monoclinic distortion is needed for IP-AHE does not hold... state explicitly which tensor components are allowed in mmm and in 2/m.
No calculation includes CaRuO3 or an interface, although item 2 makes that the key question.
Please describe the fitting (peak positions, which reflections, how d_OR maps to beta)... and whether beta_LC is a layer average or is weighted toward the interfaces.

Replace CaRuO3 with an insulating or low-SOC perovskite buffer whose octahedral rotations can be matched. This tests whether the structural transfer, rather than Ru spin-orbit coupling or proximity, matters.
The gating result is not shown to come from a structural or symmetry reconfiguration... There is also no experimental measurement of beta_LC... after gating.
The Methods give no... antisymmetrization procedure... Also explain how the planar Hall component, which is even in M, was removed in Fig. 3b,d.
Only a 2theta-omega CaRuO3 peak shift is reported (Supplementary Fig. 24)... Give an estimate of the proton content.
Fig. 1f covers only ±2.5 kOe, far below the out-of-plane saturation field of a manganite film, so it does not give the conventional AHE coefficient.
The calculation uses U = 8 eV and J = 2 eV on Mn... These choices are not tested; please show the sensitivity of sigma_DFT to U
the experiment shows about a 30-fold change in sigma between beta_LC - 90 of about 0.03 and about 0.2 degrees (Fig. 4f,g). DFT gives a factor of about 2.
Vary the LCMO thickness at fixed tCRO = 16 u.c. to separate a bulk-LCMO contribution from an interface one.

notes: C3 and C10 are marked 'partly' because the review (P19, P21) challenges whether monoclinic P21/m lowering is needed or distinguished from orthorhombic Pbnm anisotropy in the (110)O orientation rather than asking directly for P21/m verification or general necessary/sufficient statements. C2 is 'partly' because P16/P5 propose alternative control stacks (bilayers, non-Ru buffer) to isolate CRO's role rather than a mirror-symmetric CRO/LCMO/CRO sample. C9 is 'partly' because P10 requests estimating the experimental proton content rather than direct chemical/spatial profiling of selective CRO protonation. C13 is 'partly' because P13 critiques the weak factor-of-2 variation in sigma_DFT across beta_LC values rather than numerical noise or the cubic baseline.
